description:
Swadeshi since 1906 and proud of it! The Bombay Store enjoys a unique legacy as one of the oldest & most popular lifestyle destinations with roots tracing from India’s freedom struggle. We offer a fantastic selection of exquisite artefacts, authentic pashminas, divine fragrances, bedroom furnishings, home and wall décor, stationery, souvenirs, tableware and complete range of fashion apparel & accessories too!

Our mission is to give our customers an experience to “Discover a New India” through our innovative range of products reflective of a blend of contemporary & traditional Indian Culture. Our intention is for every customer visiting our stores to take home a piece of India with them.

featured_reviews.name: Harsh Gavhane
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited the Grand Trunk Furniture Shop and was absolutely blown away by the quality and variety of antique furniture they offer. From the moment I walked in, I was greeted by a warm and knowledgeable staff who were eager to help me find the perfect pieces for my home.

The shop is beautifully curated, with a stunning collection of antiques that range from classic Victorian to mid-century modern. Each piece tells its own unique story, and it’s clear that the owners have a deep appreciation and respect for the craftsmanship of the past.

I purchased a gorgeous oak dining table and a pair of intricately carved chairs, and I couldn’t be happier with my choices. The pieces are not only beautiful but also functional and have added so much character to my home. The quality of the furniture is exceptional, and it’s evident that they are well-maintained and restored with great care.

In addition to the incredible furniture, the customer service was top-notch. The staff took the time to answer all of my questions and provided valuable insights into the history and provenance of the items I was interested in. They even offered delivery and assembly services, which made the whole process seamless and stress-free.

If you’re in the market for unique, high-quality antique furniture, I highly recommend the Grand Trunk Furniture Shop. It’s a true gem, and I look forward to returning in the future to add more beautiful pieces to my collection.

featured_reviews.name: Kanchan Shetty
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had given up on the idea of getting some antique pieces for my house after seeing the prices in some of the stores I explored in mumbai before Grand Trunk. This place made my dreams come up. The place has some genuinely antique furniture from all over the country, carrying the intricate works from the south to the grandeur of Marwar and more. It’s like you’re transported to a different era. Additionally, the store upcycles a lot of antique items to make new things - for example they used a small, intricately carved door to make a dining table - which simply looks fabulous. They’ve used cycle pedals to make foot rest for bar stools. You can very clearly see that there is an elect or quirk and creativity, which is honestly so hard to find. If you still do not find what you need… they custom make furniture’s for you as well. The owner Kadir is extremely patient and very helpful. They have an even bigger workshop in Nerul which is simply mind blowing to say the least. I had a hard time choosing all of the things I wanted… because honestly I want them all!!! 😃
Must visit guys - support local business and take a right step towards sustainability by buying existing furniture and items!

name: Mysore Creation
description:
Mysore Creation, founded in 1958 by Shri. A.R. Nikam, is a celebration of master craftsmanship in Indian Handicrafts. Being a craftsman himself, he aimed at promoting and uplifting under his able guidance artists from South India, thus giving raw talent a fulfilling direction.
Mysore Creation aims to represent the finesse and divine aspect of Indian Handicrafts.
Endless hours of designing and experimental use of raw materials resulted in a beautiful confluence of creativity to bring about the Grandeur of Indian Mythology.
While we strive to continue the legacy, we hope our journey attracts people who understand and appreciate the splendor of Indian Art.

featured_reviews.name: Nirupama Kadam
featured_reviews.review_text:
To me Mysore Creation is not just a store but an enriching experience each time I visit it.
A wide range of artifacts both period and contemporary , in various mediums such as in brass,copper,bronze ,wood ..greet you at the entrance .
The displays are interesting ...
Sneha , the talented artist who is a co- owner of the store has displayed her brilliant paintings too..
Well ! I can say most modestly that I own 7 paintings of hers and a tall wood carving of God Vishnu in a seated posture...I love the stone finish look which Sneha has given to it thus making it look like ...tge old world charm !!
The hanging antique brass diyas in the store have caught my attention and I do plan to buy them .
The statues of Lord Ganesha ,Lord Hanuman and Lord Shiva are crafted in one piece wood by special artisans who hail from across the country offering an insight into the enchanting mythology of our country..the ethic fabric of Indian art is strongly felt whilst one is walking through the gallery .
Each time I visit here I am filled with joy.
Thankyou Sneha for your service at all times .
Your spectacular range of paintings interest me too..!!
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you so much for your kind words. It was such a pleasure to see your keen interest in all our pieces. We truly value your patronage and are so glad our creations have found a place in your beautiful home.
